a: Logs, metrics, and traces are the three pillars of observability.
Log JSON fields (request_id, user_id, latency) for searchable events.
Correlation/request IDs tie logs across services for one user request.
RED: Rate, Errors, Duration — useful service health metrics.
USE: Utilization, Saturation, Errors — useful for resources (CPU, disk, queues).
Tracing follows a request across services with spans and parent links.
Too many noisy alerts cause ignored pages — alert on symptoms with good thresholds.
MTTR is mean time to recover; MTBF is mean time between failures.
Severity levels (SEV1–SEV4) prioritize impact and response speed.
Communicate impact, ETA, and workarounds during incidents.
Error budgets balance reliability targets against release velocity.
Chaos engineering injects failures to test resilience in controlled ways.
